batches.1: Annals of Mathematics, issues from January 2016 to September 2026, algebraic number theory and arithmetic geometry read inclusively (the maintainer's classification, 21 September 2026). Four of its papers were routed earlier and are among the guides: Pan (2026), Betts–Stix (2025), Skinner (2020) and Balakrishnan–Dogra–Müller–Tuitman–Vonk (2019).
batches.2: Six journals (Inventiones, Duke, Forum of Mathematics Pi, JAMS, Publications de l'IHÉS, Acta), issues from 21 September 2016 to 21 September 2026, the same scope as batch 1: the maintainer's working catalogue, not exhaustive (Duke, JAMS, earlier Inventiones and recent Acta are incomplete). Three of its papers were already covered and are not queued: Lawrence–Venkatesh (DESIGN-LV), Boxer–Calegari–Gee–Pilloni 2021 (DESIGN-BCGP18) and Pan's first paper (the foundation of DESIGN-PAN).
batches.3: The seven papers the maintainer gave as routing guides (21 September 2026), queued for extraction on 23 September 2026 at the maintainer's request: their routes are already decided and applied, so each extraction reads the paper in full and routes its items into the roadmap its guide entry names.
